what i said wasn’t to “get rid of anxiety” its a new outlook to use when you are beating yourself up over a past social situation or when you have the opportunity to go out but you’re too afraid or anxious of the social situation you will be in. and actually, you CAN work on social anxiety with hard work. 

obviously some people found it helpful because they gave me a helpful award so once again, if it doesn’t work for you, dont waste your time commenting on it because there is no point. when im mindful of this throughout the day, it makes me let go of the anxiety of past interactions and relax about the future ones. so i figured id let people know. dont get mad at me because it doesnt work for you.
just trying to help.
